name: Church Building
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of prioritizing God's house, urging His people to rebuild and honor it as a place where His glory dwells and peace is given (Haggai 1:4, 8; 2:9). Christ declares that His church is built upon the foundation of faith, a spiritual structure that no force can overcome (Matthew 16:18). Moreover, the presence of Christ is assured where believers gather in His name, underscoring the communal and divine nature of the church (Matthew 18:20). The mission to build the church also involves active proclamation of the gospel to all nations, fulfilling Christ’s command to spread His message worldwide (Mark 16:15).
